summary: ProFrac Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 5 to its Alpine Term Loan Credit Agreement and Amendment No. 2 to its Guarantee Agreement, dated September 11, 2026. The amendment permits PIK election on 675 basis points of interest for twelve months beginning September 1, 2026, extends maturity from January 26, 2029 to February 15, 2030, cuts quarterly amortization from $15 million to zero through March 2028, requires 100% excess cash flow prepayments, restricts distributions subject to a $1 million annual basket, and curtails certain negative covenants. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
